root_cause.text: The `af_alg_alloc_tsgl` function in the AF_ALG crypto interface fails to clear the end-of-list marker on the last entry of a full scatter/gather list (SGL) when chaining a newly allocated SGL to it.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that `sg_unmark_end(sg + MAX_SGL_ENTS - 1)` was added to `af_alg_alloc_tsgl()` in `crypto/af_alg.c` to explicitly clear the end marker of the previous SGL's last entry before calling `sg_chain()`.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The `af_alg_alloc_tsgl` function in the AF_ALG crypto interface fails to clear the end-of-list marker on the last entry of a full scatter/gather list (SGL) when chaining a newly allocated SGL to it.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch diff shows that `sg_unmark_end(sg + MAX_SGL_ENTS - 1)` was added to `af_alg_alloc_tsgl()` in `crypto/af_alg.c` to explicitly clear the end marker of the previous SGL's last entry before calling `sg_chain()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Clear the end-of-list marker on the previous scatterlist before chaining it to a newly allocated table in af_alg_alloc_tsgl.
intent_record.what: Added a call to sg_unmark_end on the last element of the existing scatterlist before chaining it to the newly allocated scatterlist table, wrapping the block in curly braces.
intent_record.how: This ensures that the end-of-list marker on the previous scatterlist is cleared before chaining, preventing traversal algorithms from stopping prematurely and ensuring they correctly proceed to the chained scatterlist.

grouping_result.intent: Clear the end-of-list marker on the previous scatterlist before chaining it to a newly allocated table in af_alg_alloc_tsgl.

relevance_review.reason: The group's core intent is to clear the end-of-list marker on the previous scatterlist before chaining, which directly addresses the vulnerability root cause where the function failed to clear this marker.

candidates.rationale: The function chains the previous scatterlist 'sg' to the newly allocated 'sgl->sg' using sg_chain, but fails to clear the end-of-list marker on 'sg' (via sg_unmark_end) before doing so, which causes the scatter/gather list to be prematurely terminated.

vuln_statements.explanation: The function chains the previous scatterlist 'sg' to the newly allocated 'sgl->sg' using sg_chain, but fails to clear the end-of-list marker on the last entry of 'sg' (via sg_unmark_end) before doing so, which causes the scatter/gather list to be prematurely terminated.
